provenance: GSM8K solve rate for the PaLM family at three scales, quoted verbatim from the per-scale results table in the appendix of Wei et al. 2022 'Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in LLMs' (the numbers drawn as its Figure 4): standard prompting 8B 4.9, 62B 9.6, 540B 17.9; chain-of-thought 8B 4.1, 62B 29.9, 540B 56.9. points hold the chain-of-thought curve (x = parameters in billions, y = solve rate %); fit.params carries both curves and the page draws them together on a log-x axis. Note the honesty beat kept in-app: at 8B, chain of thought is BELOW standard (4.1 vs 4.9) — the paper calls the ability emergent with scale.
